messages:
maria: FYI I opened a PR to add the sample generator examples and a few UX copy tweaks for the Optimize toolkit docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4245 — includes batching+caching example + small quant profile table.

aj: Thanks — skimmed. CI already flagged a link-check error on the preview build.

aj: CI error snippet:
```
ERROR: docs-link-check: broken link /optimize/examples/sample-gen -> 404
  at /docs/optimize/toolkit/README.md:142
```

sam: Looks like the example path changed after the samplegen refactor (we moved samples/ -> examples/sample-gen). Quick fix is to update the README link to /optimize/examples/sample-gen or add a redirect.

maria: Ugh, I must have rebased against the refactor branch and missed that path. I can patch the README in this PR.

aj: If you want to patch in this PR, add a small test case in examples/ci/ that exercise the route so link-check catches it locally. Example command: `yarn docs:link-check ./docs/optimize/toolkit/README.md`

hana: Also, the quant table in the PR has a stray header cell — it renders oddly in the preview. I can take a quick pass on the markdown cell spacing.

maria: Thanks — will update both. Also want to add a short SDK snippet for python batching that uses the new sample-gen helper:```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
resp = client.generate_batch(model='redwood-opt-v1', inputs=["hi","hello"], batch_size=8, prefetch=True)
print(resp.outputs)
```

sam: Can you also include the minimal output JSON example? reviewers often ask for that.

maria: Good call, adding a small `expected_output.json` under docs/examples/ so the preview shows a live sample.

docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-previews.redwood.com/4245 (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

aj: Re-ran link-check locally, clean now. CI will re-run once you push.

ci-bot: Check started: docs-lint, docs-link-check, preview-build (run #286).

ci-bot: docs-lint passed.

ci-bot: docs-link-check failed: found one normalized redirect from /optimize/examples/sample-gen -> /examples/sample-gen (301). Suggest updating canonical path.

maria: Pushed fix to canonical path and added redirect note in top of README. PTAL.

ci-bot: All checks passed. Preview link updated: https://deploy-previews.redwood.com/4245

sam: Reviewed and left a tiny nit on the SDK snippet naming, otherwise LGTM.

hana: Gloss edits applied. Looks good in the preview.

maria: Thanks all — merging now. Will follow up with a tiny follow-up PR to add the example runner to the examples CI job so this catches earlier. :rocket:
